[8:54PM] #OjoduBerger #TrafficUpdate 

Movement from Isheri Olowora towards River Valley is fast-moving. However, slight delays are observed from River Valley enroute Kosoko due to pedestrian crossings and commercial activities in the area.
Traffic towards VIS, Omole Gate, and down to Omole Junction is smooth.
There is also appreciable movement towards Excellence, Yaya Abatan, Kayode, Caterpillar, Odo Eran, and Wempco, all good.
The return route from Wempco through Odo Eran and Caterpillar is also good.
Traffic from Wempco to Lateef Jakande, connecting Omole Junction, Omole Gate, VIS, River Valley, and back to Isheri Olowora, is moving appreciably well.
Officers are on ground ensuring smooth flow, and no impediments have been reported. The entire area remains calm and orderly.

#FollowLASTMA
